title: Design interview: lock glossary surface for Auto-Heal & Bottleneck Monitor
description: Resolved the full design-interview surface (grill-with-docs) into CONTEXT.md as a 21-term glossary plus ADR 0001 (fail-fast startup config contract). Covers detection (Poll, Bottleneck, Hysteresis, Sustained Bottleneck N), attribution (Blocker, Blocker Identity Resolution, multi-root graph), action (Auto-Heal KILL QUERY one-per-poll, Heal Cooldown M, Kill-Exclusion allowlist), blindness (Monitor Blindness K, Attribution Blindness J, blindness-freeze observational-vs-temporal invariant), failure (Heal Capability Failure, idle-trx blind spot), reporting (State Toggle, Recovery Alert, Durable Log, Kill Audit Record, Alert Payload, Alert Delivery Contract = Telegram V1). Final tunable set N/M/K/J and 4-signal set are locked. Interview reached saturation (later questions answered by existing text). No source code yet (greenfield).
close_reason: Design interview complete; 21-term glossary + ADR 0001 captured in CONTEXT.md. Interview saturated. Committing artifacts.
